items.title: Shane Steichen on Daniel Jones: We'll evaluate everything

items.text: Burrow and Cam Ward had an exciting quarterback duel in Cincinnati.

items.title: Dan Campbell had "no new information" on Jack Campbell after Sunday's win
items.text: Lions linebacker Jack Campbell was carted off the field while on a backboard during Sunday's win over the Vikings and there's no immediate word on his condition.

items.title: Lamar Jackson to have thumb surgery, could be out for season
items.text: Jackson was injured early in Sunday's loss to the Bills.

items.text: Jackson left with a right thumb injury on the Ravens' first play from scrimmage.

items.title: Lions hand Vikings first loss of the season, Detroit wins 19-15

items.title: Jaguars humiliate Colts in a 42-7 home win
items.text: The Colts signaled a willingness to quit on their season by trading guard Quenton Nelson and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner this week and the rest of the team showed they are more than willing to take a knee on Sunday.
